About

Great Resignations are killing the market. More than 40% of workers are not satisfied with their work, and Gen Z starts to reclaim different work policies and a better environment. Companies are now starting to fight the challenge, but they are losing it miserably. Mentoring is the game changer. We developed a scientific methodology based on data to run global mentoring programs with world star mentors from more than 10 countries. We are able to mix neuroscience, behavioral sciences, and positive psychology to foster people growth and offer to HR departments a complete overview of performance and happiness of employees.
